note: Drew item 21. Ten-card insert, 1:8 hobby and retail, transcribed verbatim from BCP's Heavy Metal section. This is its own product, not a parallel of the 250-card base set: Heavy Metal #2 is Barry Bonds while BASE #2 is Brady Anderson, so a holding pinned to the base row prices Bonds off Brady Anderson's pool. That is exactly the defect PR #2010 recorded for holding 46f3dd96 (hiq:baseball:1996:fleer-metal-universe:2:base:no-auto). No parallels are emitted: BCP lists none for this insert.
